messages.content: Decompose and delegate as a parallel fanout, then synthesize: produce a combined briefing for our Director model decision comparing Claude Haiku vs Sonnet on (1) COST and (2) LATENCY. Fan out the two analyses to researchers, then add a synthesis subtask that depends on both and combines them into one recommendation file. Each piece writes its own file under team/drafts/. Keep each analysis well under its word limit. Do not do the work yourself; delegate it.
